name: Ask Soma - Astrology
description: Ask questions about your life, career, relationships, and timing—and get answers grounded in your personal Vedic birth chart. AskSoma connects Claude directly to your Jyotish chart, planetary positions, and today's panchang, making Vedic astrology a native part of your AI workflow. An AI-powered Jyotish mentor that gives you deeply personalized guidance, not generic horoscopes—available anytime, right inside Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ask Soma - Astrology to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ask Soma - Astrology to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.asksoma.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ask Soma - Astrology MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask Soma - Astrology lists 14 MCP tools, including ask_soma, dimensions.2, get_panchang, timings.3, check_compatibility, time, location, relationships, health, finance, nakshatra, and yoga.

_published_faq.name: Does Ask Soma - Astrology MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask Soma - Astrology requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ask Soma - Astrology is developed by AskSoma. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
